title: Fifa Asean Cup: Bjorn Kristensen brace lifts PH past Thailand

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Bjorn Kristensen scored a brace, including the winner, as the Philippine men’s football team stunned Thailand, 2-1, on Friday to end its Fifa Asean Cup campaign on a bright note. Kristensen struck the opener three minutes into the twice-delayed match in Bandung, Indonesia, before adding another in the 68th to give the Philippines the maximum three points. Iklas Sanron equalized for Thailand in the 55th, before Kristensen came through with the goal that contributed to the Filipino booters’ rare win over the regional powerhouse.
